public_payload.normalized_proposition: Jensen Huang and NVIDIA collaborators including its general counsel deliberately and repeatedly violated US commerce law.

statement.excerpt: In addition to getting his shit rocked crazy style, Jensen Huang — along with collaborators at NVIDIA including its general counsel — has deliberately and repeatedly violated US commerce law.

from_speaker: collaborators at NVIDIA including its general counsel
our_interpretation: In context, commerce law means the US export restrictions governing the alleged diversion of NVIDIA chips to China.
The claim alleges actual, knowing violations involving Huang and the general counsel, not merely wrongdoing by customers or other employees.
Repeatedly requires more than one unlawful act. A conviction is not essential if authenticated records otherwise establish the conduct and knowledge.
This is a cumulative allegation of past conduct through the post date. No starting date is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Official findings, admissions, or authenticated transaction and communication records establish repeated unlawful exports or knowing participation by Huang and NVIDIA collaborators including its general counsel.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable findings or comprehensive records establish that the alleged conduct was lawful, did not occur, or did not involve the named executives knowingly.
